card: This PR resolves startup crashes in bitcoin-qt when dynamic settings are disabled via -nosettings, specifically during legacy setting migration or when running with -resetguisettings. It also updates the GUI options dialog to alert the user if a setting failed to write to disk instead of claiming success and prompting for a restart. The diff guards NodeImpl write call sites, updates OptionsModel, and adds test coverage in optiontests.cpp. Review has not yet started.
problem: When -nosettings is used, ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile throws an exception, causing bitcoin-qt to abort on startup during legacy settings migration or when resetting GUI settings. Furthermore, failed settings writes previously closed the options dialog reporting success and prompted for a restart that would wipe in-memory changes.
summary: Fixes crashes in bitcoin-qt when running with -nosettings alongside -resetguisettings or legacy GUI settings. It guards settings writes in NodeImpl so ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile does not throw, prevents dropping legacy settings when migration cannot write to disk, and updates OptionsModel and OptionsDialog to warn when settings fail to persist.
